## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D1 (c, shell and page components). This is audit backlog UX-20 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: Components only, in /__ui. Later registration, settings, onboarding, the pregnancy card, sign-up and the platform console.
Findings and reviewers: F-23, F-19 · reviewers B-13, C-12. Part 1 of 2 of audit backlog UX-20 (part 2 moves the forms to it, one feature at a time).
Rationale: Five Field wrappers, three error styles and three required or optional conventions exist. After a failed submit, focus stays on the button and at 375 px the errors are off screen (WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.1 and 3.3.3 are weak).
Proposed UX behaviour: Field: label above the control, a required or optional mark in words (one convention per form, chosen by a prop on the form), a hint, units inside or beside the control, and an error that says what is wrong and what to do, linked with aria-describedby and marked invalid. ErrorSummary: after a failed submit it lists each error as a link to its field, takes focus, and is announced once. Both work with React Hook Form and Zod as the house rule requires and take translated strings only.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/08-design-system-blueprint.md section 9 (Forms); the NHS design system error summary as advisory reference.
Components and tokens affected: New field.tsx and error-summary.tsx in packages/ui.
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the D1a tickets for control defaults and type tokens. File ownership: its two files, tests and gallery section.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Effort and regression risk: M · Low: no form uses it yet.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Moving any existing form (part 2). (2) Date and time pickers in the app language (a later ticket).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a sample form in the gallery with three invalid fields, when it is submitted, then focus moves to the summary, which lists three links, and activating a link focuses that field
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the same form at 375 px, when it is submitted empty, then the summary is in the viewport
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a Field with an error, when it renders, then the message is text beside the field, linked to the control, and the control is marked invalid without relying on colour
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a form set to mark required fields, when it renders, then every required field carries the word in the label and no asterisk stands alone
- [ ] **AC5.** Given a screen reader, when the summary appears, then it is announced once and not repeated on every keystroke
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the gallery in English and Arabic, when axe runs, then there is no violation

## Test notes

- Vitest: summary links, required convention.
- Playwright on /__ui: failed submit, focus on the summary, link moves focus; 375 and 1440; en and ar; axe.
